title: Build an AI Model of Yourself on Your Mac with MCP
description:
Turns out you can build an AI model of yourself right on your Mac 🤯 Instead of Claude or Codex replying to everyone the same way, it makes a personal model of how you think, what matters to you, whats still unfinished. The wild part it hooks into your agents over MCP, so one prompt gives a diffrent answer tuned to each person ✨🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
